transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for getting together. transcript.text: My reception has exactly 36 guests, and I'll provide exactly 36 boxed lunches in exchange for the PA — 30 regular lunches and 6 vegetarian lunches, with no cash payment. I can pick up the PA on Saturday at 10 AM and I'll return it on Sunday at 8 PM.

transcript.text: I've confirmed the venue's electrical limits for Sunday evening. Only 600 watts remain available on the shared circuit because the kitchen warmers use the rest. So the PA can be used with the two standard speakers, but not with the subwoofer.
